style: purple/black icon-first accent piece; a small hand-drawn line-art storefront icon sits dim and easy to miss in the dark, then a spotlight beam sweeps in from one side and lands on it, brightening it dramatically with a glow bloom; a short punchy label resolves beneath. Single continuous accumulating scene (nothing exits) so the alpha-overlay export is never blank. League Gothic for the label, Montserrat stack for weight consistency with sibling pieces.

customize.note: Searched npx hyperframes catalog for 'spotlight beam sweep illuminate icon' and 'icon reveal glow illuminate dim to bright'. Nearest hits: yt-feather-highlight ('Feathered Spotlight' — dims the frame except a feathered ellipse, CSS-var driven, built for gliding a highlight between UI targets/cursor-tracking) and tracing-beam (a glowing dash following an SVG path across UI elements). Neither covers a directional cone beam rotating in from off-frame to land on a small hand-drawn icon with a dim-to-bright color/glow transform on the icon itself — hand-authored per builder-contract, reusing the established purple-brand CSS custom properties, persistent #bg-fill, back.out/power-eased vocabulary, and single continuous-scene technique already proven in sibling icon pieces (restaurant-no-sign, demand-reputation-flywheel).

scenes.motion: bg-fill fades in (0-0.15s); a small line-art storefront icon (roofline + body + door + two windows, stroke-only) fades in muted/dim (var(--muted)), low opacity (~0.55), slightly undersized scale (~0.82) — reads as small and easy to overlook

a translucent cone beam (CSS clip-path triangle, apex fixed above the icon's x-position, gradient fill in accent-bright) fades in and rotates from -32deg to 0deg (1.5-2.6s, power2.inOut) so it visibly sweeps in from the left and lands directly on the icon; as the beam lands (~2.3s) the icon transforms in place: color muted->accent-bright, opacity 0.55->1, scale 0.82->1.06->1.0 (back.out punch), a radial glow blob blooms behind it (opacity 0->0.65); beam settles from full brightness to a lower ambient hold once landed (2.6-3.0s) rather than exiting, so the icon stays lit for the remainder
label fades/slides up into place beneath the now-lit icon at 3.0s (power2.out), brief text-shadow glow pulse for punch, then freeze-holds unchanged to the end of the timeline (5.0s) for a clean cut
